content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-128. - Death benefits.
content.summary:
When any member or retirant shall die and leave a dependent widow, dependent widower,
               dependent mother, dependent father, child or children under the age of 18 years, surviving,
               such beneficiaries shall receive a monthly allotment as provided for in
section 86-152
.
